title: Fig and the Storm
note: b416 — Phase 4 continues (Learning) — new consonant clusters st, sw, tr.

pages.brief: Fig the caterpillar resting on a puddle-dotted garden path under a grey sky.
Dark clouds rolling in quickly over the garden path.
Fig the caterpillar hurrying off the open path towards shelter.
Fig the caterpillar making his way under the edge of a wide leaf.
Fig the caterpillar sitting motionless, tucked safely under the wide leaf.
Heavy raindrops splashing on the garden path outside the sheltering leaf.
Fig the caterpillar warm and dry under the leaf as rain falls around him.
The rain easing off, sunlight starting to break through the clouds.
Fig the caterpillar setting off again along the now-dry path, looking content.
